features.title: Platform foundation, delivery and non-functional baseline
features.summary: Repos, CI/CD, environments, database, web app shell, observability, load/availability/localisation baselines, go-live readiness.

features.title: Sign-in, roles and staff accounts
features.summary: Patient phone-code sign-in, staff password sign-in, role-based visibility with clinic scoping, staff account management, privacy and erasure.

features.title: Clinics, dentist hours, leave, treatments and free slots
features.summary: Clinics and dentists as data, weekly hours and breaks, leave with to-move list, treatment types, free-slot calculation.

features.title: Patient online booking
features.summary: Patient books a slot online (clinic, treatment, dentist or first available), never double-booked, with channel choice remembered.

features.title: Patient appointment list, reschedule, cancel and status history
features.summary: Patient sees appointments, reschedules and cancels until 4 hours before, freed slot reusable, status history with actor.

features.title: Reception day view, check-in, no-show and dentist day
features.summary: Reception day view per clinic, book/move/cancel for callers and walk-ins, arrived, no-show and undo; dentist read-only day.

features.title: Confirmations, reminders, STOP and SMS fallback
features.summary: Message templates, confirmations, 24-hour reminders with quiet hours, channel adapters for SMS/WhatsApp, STOP, WhatsApp-to-SMS fallback, reminders-failed list.

features.title: Family members on a patient account (Release 2)
features.summary: Patient adds up to 5 family members and books for them; each booking names the person.

features.title: Repeat no-show block and no-show report (Release 2)
features.summary: Block online booking after 2 no-shows in 6 months, lift by reception, monthly no-show report per clinic.
